subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu Group Chat SubAgents for User-Specific Skills and Memory

question: Should OpenClaw extend the Feishu plugin from sender/topic session isolation and DM dynamic agents into an automatic group per-sender subagent lifecycle?
rationale: The request crosses product behavior, security boundaries, memory isolation, skills/config ownership, quotas, and cleanup policy; current main has adjacent primitives but no approved default semantics for auto-spawning group subagents.

options.title: Design default-off Feishu group subagents
options.body: Approve a bounded Feishu-plugin design that is explicit, configurable, and validated for memory/security isolation before implementation.

options.title: Use existing session scoping only
options.body: Keep groupSessionScope plus manual/thread-bound subagent flows as the supported path and document that automatic group subagents are out of scope for now.

options.title: Move to external plugin experiment
options.body: Ask interested teams to prototype the orchestration as a separate Feishu/ClawHub integration until a missing core API is proven.

recommendation.title: Design default-off Feishu group subagents
recommendation.body: Approve a bounded Feishu-plugin design that is explicit, configurable, and validated for memory/security isolation before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package identifies this handle as the community maintainer, and the decision is primarily Feishu plugin product/security behavior.
